api_list.name: Details
api_list.description: Get the details and general information of a Creator with the `creator_id`.

required_parameters.name: creator_id
required_parameters.description: The `creator_id` can be obtained using the `/search` endpoint.

api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://patreon8.p.rapidapi.com/details/2416483"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "patreon8.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())

attributes.summary:
If you are from country that is blocked by Patreon, we are testing alternative platform for these of you that can't get access to our work thru Patreon. However Patreon remain main way how to access our work. If you can't buy memberships on Patreon tho, check out this link > https://www.buymeacoffee.com/adnrstudio

Up to date list of all changes done > https://gtareal.club/read-about/

Feel the real LA experience from the comfort of your home, 5Real is the first revolutionary GTA V mod pack helping you to transform the whole world of Los Santos into Los Angeles with ease. 5Real adds real architecture, real traffic, real terrains, real graphics and much more. We will be continuously releasing more updates including physics, peds and in short everything! To read FAQ join our Discord using this link, FAQ channel is public > https://discord.gg/sEpRcwjeNW

What we're working on ?

GTA V is most popular game in the world for using mods with decoded most of it's files to be able edit them (thanks to great teams who did that), and we decided to make it even better. What I mean better is to make it more realistic, I mean most realistic ever! To feel more like you are in parallel world of ours. We don't want to share violence and other things that are happening in this game, on the contrary, more realistic it will feel in the game, the less stupid things people may do in real world. We believe in it.

What will we provide you in here ?

On my long way to create most realistic version of GTA ever I encounter lot of difficulties about modding and meet some great modders, some of them became part of this project. It's still a long way until finish of this project. But until that day D, we would like to share beta access, to let you experience actual content which is like basement what many of you are looking for. Beta access will not only speed up whole project but will as well help us faster find and fix all glitches and let you enjoy all the content right from it's beginning. No matter if you just started with modding or you are experienced, we would do our best to get valuable guides for every level of experiences. You may even learn whole new skills or just install and enjoy our work.

What would be next ?

Basement pack which may look for many of you like the top pack ever made, is for us just a start of the journey to make real life based alt world. You can expect expansion of our team and our skills to get you all in one pack at the finish. As well we have lot of ideas what we would like to create and bring to you, but it all want a time and in this your support is very important help for completing this project as soon as possible. More what is content of a basement pack you can find in this article - https://adnrstudio.medium.com/exlpained-gta-5real-.... Every month we'll write update goals and updates content in our Discord. You can get access to these news just by 'Copper' tier to get all latest information.

import requests

url = "https://patreon8.p.rapidapi.com/search/adnr studios"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "patreon8.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
